title: Constraint Expansion
equation: Growth = Bottleneck Capacity Added ÷ Prior Capacity
hook: Working more hours didn't grow my business. Fixing the one step everything waited on did.
statement: Real growth means finding your biggest bottleneck and deliberately making it bigger.
explainer: Every business has one step that caps everything else. Improve anything around it and output stays flat. Widen that one step and the whole thing moves.
sop: Map your process and find the step everything else waits on.
Ask yourself: if I fixed this, would output actually go up?
Expand that one step. Hire, delegate, upgrade the tool, or change the process.
Compare Bottleneck Capacity Added to your Prior Capacity each quarter.
Once it's fixed, find the next bottleneck. There's always one.
equation_example: Your bottleneck handled 100 units a week. This quarter you added 15. 15 ÷ 100 = 15% growth. Higher means you're actually moving your ceiling. Close to zero means you keep hitting the same wall.
question: Name the one step in your business that everything else is waiting on.
closing_statement: Fix anything but the real bottleneck and nothing changes.
caption:
Principle Nº 140: Constraint Expansion

Working more hours didn't grow my business. Fixing the one step everything waited on did.

Real growth means finding your biggest bottleneck and deliberately making it bigger.
